title: Native KaTeX compositor conformance

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
User-approved 27-slice development-only compositor conformance proposal with hard scenario budgets, a mandatory ncc19 two/x checkpoint, rollback units, and a named carrier-loop return target.

allowedWork: Development-only typed shape descriptors, deterministic coverage planning, actual-paint observation, seam diagnostics, bounded browser fixtures, one evidence-driven shared typography repair, feature-class pressure, and production-exclusion gates.
Reuse existing Native KaTeX measurement, ownership, lifecycle, deterministic-clock, catalogue-host, and release-gate infrastructure; matrices are diagnostic compound fixtures only.
disallowedWork: No glyph, equation, fixture, or caller-specific offsets; no semantic, correspondence, choreography, timing, URL, static endpoint, authoring, lesson, layout, public-product, Svelte, SVG, Canvas, or WebGL changes.

No production import of the suite, aesthetic certification, planned geometry presented as actual paint, silent fallback, unbounded fuzzing, or carrier-family promotion before the ncc19 checkpoint and ncc27 closeout.
goal: Build a bounded development-only feature-class conformance suite, repair the shared realized-paint handoff exposed by italic x without changing canonical 2, stop for human review, then expand and return to carrier promotion.
commitCadence: Commit each independently reversible verified control-plane, schema-planner, observer-reporter, shared-repair, fixture-family, and closeout boundary with exact path staging; emit loop status at slice, commit, and stop boundaries.
stopConditions: Stop at ncc19 for explicit human visual approval of the canonical 2 and italic x handoff before any shape-family expansion.
Stop if test-only conformance code enters a production closure or affects browser bundle bytes.
Stop if repair requires a glyph, equation, fixture, or caller-specific offset, or if observation cannot distinguish realized paint from planned geometry.
Stop if hard scenario, sample, page, or worker budgets are exceeded or browser variance cannot be classified.
Stop if work begins encoding aesthetics, changes semantic or timing authority, expands matrices into lesson design, or alters approved behavior outside the paint seam.

slices.title: Priority-cutover
slices.summary: Completed the approved cutover: rejected cps21 is durable, carrier run and broad target are deferred at cps22 with an explicit return condition, malformed v1 controls are superseded, complete v2 owns all 27 slices and hard stops, project hygiene is unblocked, and unrelated files remain protected.

slices.title: Baseline-evidence
slices.summary: Added a test-only deterministic baseline and stable command. It classifies canonical 2's 0.28125px excursion as continuous, freezes italic x's symmetric 13.828125px handoff displacement as a known regression, and keeps =4 explicitly stationary; no compositor behavior changed.

slices.title: Inventory-existing-seams
slices.summary: Recorded the existing authority chain from semantic recipe through native paint, endpoint handles, ownership, track sampling, material cloning, settlement, lifecycle invalidation, and browser harness. The only missing proof is a correlated actual-material-paint trace; no second renderer, clock, endpoint model, or measurement algorithm is needed.

slices.title: Define-terminology
slices.summary: Defined semantic object, shape and paint classes, context mutation, ownership topology, lifecycle action, ownership seam, planned geometry, realized paint, seam trace, supported transition, and the three explicit coordinate spaces. The principle also separates certifiable continuity laws from human motion aesthetics.

slices.title: Freeze-cost-budgets
slices.summary: Added executable test-only budgets: 24-scenario canary, 96-scenario promotion, 12 scenarios per browser engine, five semantic samples, one page and worker, no routine screenshots, no unseeded fuzz, reusable server/browser/page, structured diagnostics, and advisory wall-time ceilings.

slices.title: Add-shape-schema
slices.summary: Added an immutable test-only shape descriptor and registry. It names representative LaTeX, structural class, paint metric, ownership grain, and baseline capability; rejects contradictory atomic/rule/multirow measurement contracts, blanks, duplicates, and empty registries; and contains no timing or pedagogy fields.

slices.title: Add-risk-tags
slices.summary: Added glyph, rule, script, vertical-list, delimiter, multirow, and font-style risk tags. Shape constructors require the relevant structural tag, reject duplicates, and store canonical order; italic x is described compositionally as glyph plus font-style risk, not as a caller branch.
